landing.tagline: A saga of the north, played together.

multiplayer.title: Multiplayer
multiplayer.text: Every other realm on the island is a real player. Ally with them or raid them.

noPayToWin.title: No pay to win
noPayToWin.text: Premium supports the game and only adds quality-of-life features.

adFree.title: Ad-free
adFree.text: An indie game, made with love. No ads.

beats.fire: Listen! Come closer to the fire, and hear how the jarls lost their home.
beats.prophecy: The seers foretold it: their halls would burn, and the sea would take the land.
beats.ravens: The ravens came back with word: Bjarnøy is not empty. Under the sea, the giants sleep.
beats.sending: The jarl put his only son into your hands. His whole line sails with the boy, and you are sworn to see him to a new shore.
beats.hold: The coast was gone behind us. Ahead there was only fog, the beat of the oars, and the boy at the prow.
